sloka: भगवन्पूर्वमप्येषा लङ्कासीत्पिशिताशिनाम् ।श्रुत्वेदं भगवद्वाक्यं जातो मे विस्मयः परः ।। ७.४.३ ॥
transliteration: bhagavanpūrvamapyeṣā laṅkāsītpiśitāśinām ।śrutvedaṁ bhagavadvākyaṁ jāto me vismayaḥ paraḥ ।। 7.4.3 ॥

translations.english: O revered one, having heard your statement that this Lanka formerly belonged to the flesh-eaters, a great astonishment has arisen within me.
